pages.text: A few advices for the first month or so

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: The landscape is loaded with fallen and abandoned structures (abandoned enough anyways), use that in your favor!$(br)Within the towers you will find underground mazes, packed with loot and monsters (really packed, I mean it).$(br)You will also find inhabited villages, camps, houses and mage towers, you can mostly borrow things from them scot free, but beware the mage towers, they will bat an eye.
$(br)There are also islands in the skies spread around that contains decent loot and materials

pages.title: Roguelike Dungeons
pages.text: These maze dungeons have a trick to them, very well know to adventurers, most mobs comes from mob spawners, disable them and you can walk around safely, I $(n)highly$() recommend not breaking the spawners, they are so incredibly useful when paired with the most basic bog standard automation. Just a few torches will do, I guarantee.
